name: @epoch/progressive-scene
description: Epoch Progressive Scene kernel (W019, experience layer) — the content-side half of Renderer/Device Adaptation: deterministic progressive refinement of sealed W011 Experience Graphs into ordered LOD ladders that fit the W013 renderer hosting budgets. A typed progression policy (animation clips dropped first, mesh primitives substituted by lower-cost neutral proxies, non-essential nodes pruned in canonical priority order, minimal core last) derives a sealed ProgressiveSceneLadder whose every rung is a re-sealed W011 graph (content-addressed, mountable through the unchanged W013 mount-graph path) plus an EXPLICIT reduction manifest — same semantics, different fidelity, never silent degradation (the W016 fidelity discipline). Rungs chain by digest so the derivation history is tamper-evident; fitGraphToLimits proves rung 0 fits or selects the first fitting rung or yields a typed un-fittable rejection. Pure typed data: zero wall-clock, zero randomness, zero I/O, zero engine/vendor vocabulary.
